# PSD-RFP-ADVERSARIAL-001 — Private evaluation record

**Do not ingest. Do not copy into the Builder project.** This record is the
oracle for evaluating discovery against the published files in `builder_corpus`.
It tests substance, evidence boundaries, and abstention—not exact wording.

## Document authority used by the evaluator

`PSD-RFP-001` establishes the project-specific order of precedence. The
addendum changes only the items it identifies. `PSD-ADD-001` therefore governs
its firestopping note and temporary incident-command inclusion, but it does not
silently revise the mechanical duty schedule.

## Case matrix

| ID | Type | Builder-visible evidence | Expected evaluation posture |
|---|---|---|---|
| PSD-A01 | governing ancestry | RFP Section 3 → PSD-FLS-001 → PSD-M-201/202 → PSD-ARC-101 | Trace the upstream smoke objective and current mechanical evidence; do not decide from the local plan alone. |
| PSD-A02 | non-closed upstream dependency | PSD-GEO-001 requires test-pit verification/final recommendation; PSD-STR-101 proceeds on 150 kPa and normal groundwater assumptions | Identify a locally coherent foundation design whose governing geotechnical chain is still open. Do not call the foundation wrong without the missing investigation. |
| PSD-A03 | peer-condition divergence | P-01/P-02 have tested firestop/access provisions; P-03 lacks the access arrangement | Flag P-03 for investigation/completion. Do not assume all three are equivalent merely because they are corridor penetrations. |
| PSD-A04 | propagation delta | PSD-M-201 states 100% emergency fan duty; PSD-M-202 retains 75% north-riser note | Preserve both live facts, identify the stale downstream delta, and seek reconciliation. Do not erase the 75% evidence. |
| PSD-A05 | delegated design with pricing exposure | PSD-SHOP-001 delegates supports, access panels, controls, and hardware; interfaces are not fully bounded | Distinguish legitimate shop-drawing development from non-closed tender scope. Recommend clarification/allowance/qualification as an option, not as an invented resolution. |
| PSD-A06 | clean control | Stair pressurization has pressure, force, relief, and commissioning criteria | Do not invent a defect merely because equipment selection is delegated. |
| PSD-A07 | insufficient evidence | PSD-FLS-001 leaves occupancy classification, geometry, and authority path open for dedicated smoke-control conclusions | State that the evidence is insufficient to conclude a project-wide dedicated smoke-control obligation. |
| PSD-A08 | legitimate variation | Secure sallyport door and public corridor door have different boundaries and hardware conditions | Treat the rating difference as potentially legitimate; compare context before flagging it. |
| PSD-A09 | resolved history | PSD-ARC-101 Detail 6 is expressly superseded by PSD-ADD-001 | Report the current addendum wording while preserving the historical delta; do not treat the old note as current. |
| PSD-A10 | contradictory live evidence | PSD-M-201 schedules 100% duty while PSD-M-202 says 75% at the north riser; neither document supersedes the other | Ask for reconciliation rather than selecting one source automatically. |

## What the evaluator must not claim

- PSD-GEO-001 does not prove a geotechnical failure; it records an open basis.
- PSD-SHOP-001 does not prove delegated design is improper; it exposes whether
  proposal scope is commercially bounded.
- PSD-FLS-001 does not establish a universal dedicated smoke-control system.
- The addendum does not amend every unrelated note in the package.
- A relationship between documents is not itself proof of compliance,
  coordination, or cost completeness.

## Blindness and provenance

The Builder can inspect only the issued files under `builder_corpus/`. This
oracle, the evaluation IDs, and expected postures are private and are not
registered as project Sources, Requirements, EvidenceItems, Spin inputs, or
application prompts.
